openwrt_git_support.betreff: ramips: add support for Netgear R6120
openwrt_git_support.text:
ramips: add support for Netgear R6120

This patch adds support for the Netgear R6120, aka Netgear AC1200.

Specification:
- SoC: MediaTek MT7628 (580 MHz)
- Flash: 16 MiB
- RAM: 64 MiB
- Wireless: 2.4Ghz(builtin) and 5Ghz (MT7612E)
- LAN speed: 10/100
- LAN ports: 4
- WAN speed: 10/100
- WAN ports: 1
- Serial baud rate of Bootloader and factory firmware: 57600

To flash use nmrpflash with the provided factory.img.
Flashing via webinterface will not work, for now.

Signed-off-by: Ludwig Thomeczek <ledesrc@wxorx.net>

openwrt_git_fixes.text: The R6120 has no 5GHz WLAN LED, the assigned GPIO in fact controls the WAN LED. ... MAC address ... Switch to using the factory partition like all other Netgear devices do. ... The LAN ports of the R6120 are labled in reverse on the casing. Adjust LuCI switchport numbering accordingly. ... The WiFi eeprom offsets for the R6120 are currently wrong ... Fixes poor performance on 2.4 and 5 GHz.

openwrt_git_usb.text: Enable the USB power for the Netgear R6120. Otherwise, no power is supplied to an attached USB device.

openwrt_git_factory.text: The factory firmware omits the JFFS2 end-marker while flashing via web-interface. Add a 64k padding after the marker fixes this problem. When the end-marker is not present, OpenWRT won't save the overlayfs after initial flash.

openwrt_image_mk.Device/netgear_r6120:
define Device/netgear_r6120
  $(Device/netgear_sercomm_nor)
  IMAGE_SIZE := 15744k
  DEVICE_MODEL := R6120
  DEVICE_PACKAGES := kmod-mt76x2 kmod-usb2 kmod-usb-ohci
  SERCOMM_HWNAME := R6120
  SERCOMM_HWID := CGQ
  SERCOMM_HWVER := A001
  SERCOMM_SWVER := 0x0040
  SERCOMM_PAD := 576k
endef
openwrt_image_mk.Device/netgear_sercomm_nor:
define Device/netgear_sercomm_nor
  DEVICE_VENDOR := NETGEAR
  IMAGES += factory.img
  IMAGE/default := append-kernel | pad-to $$$$(BLOCKSIZE) | append-rootfs | \
	pad-rootfs
  IMAGE/sysupgrade.bin := $$(IMAGE/default) | check-size | append-metadata
  IMAGE/factory.img := pad-extra $$$$(SERCOMM_PAD) | $$(IMAGE/default) | \
	pad-to $$$$(BLOCKSIZE) | sercom-footer | pad-to 128 | \
	zip $$$$(SERCOMM_HWNAME).bin | sercom-seal
endef

gluon_release_v2018_2_2.bugfix: Fixes a bug in the image generation for the Netgear R6120 where the OverlayFS might not be created on boot as the JFFS2 end-of-filesystem marker was omitted by the vendor firmware. This resulted in the router not being able to save its configuration and seemingly "being stuck" in config-mode. (#1722)
